title: Hinomori Shiho — Waiting For Our Turn〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Phew...
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Nice one, Shiho.
That was a lovely performance.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, Shih, that was awesome!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You sound better than you did before the festival.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I thought you wanted to work on something specific, since you asked us to help you practice!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you seem totally fine, based on the way you played just now♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This seems like a good place to stop, so wanna call things here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I agree. How does some tea sound?
We even still have some of those snacks you girls brought over the other day.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Would you guys mind if we kept playing a bit longer?

rows.Speaker: Luka, Rin & KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why? Do you still wanna practice?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not practice per se...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, are you trying to say...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're not happy with the way you played just now, right?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Again, I thought you played really great today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I got to see you play when you were on stage, and I thought you were just as good!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Um, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, Shih!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I love how you wanna keep getting better and better! I know that you're motivated!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you never ever should push yourself too hard!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, it's just...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You practiced nonstop in preparation for that festival!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, now that it's over, I think it's time to give yourself a chance to catch your breath!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I appreciate you feeling that way, but I think you're getting the wrong idea.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not unhappy with the way I played today.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! But, you said you wanna keep playing...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Well, yeah.
I mean...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm just having a ton of fun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We played well at the festival, and I could really feel it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Practicing with you guys reminded me of that sensation. So, I kinda want to keep playing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I had a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, that's what you were trying to say?!
Geez, I totally got the wrong idea!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, I didn't express myself very clearly.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, in that case, let's keep playing a little longer.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I totally understand how it feels to lose yourself in the flow.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I think those moments are important to remember...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Still, Shih, I know you're having fun, but you shouldn't push yourself too hard! Got it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be careful.
